patria-amv.notes: 100 km/h is a conservative cap from the published >100 km/h maximum, not a guaranteed cruising speed. No separate offroad cruising speed is published in this source. Reverse speed, acceleration, braking, steering and comfort limits are simulation tuning, not manufacturer claims. Values apply to AMV 8x8, not AMV XP.
